tools.name: ecellar_get_reference_data
tools.description: Lookup lists of the winery's eCellar account: brands = brands (brand_key + name); locations = locations (location_id, name, timezone); customer_types = customer types; customer_sources = customer sources; customer_tags = customer tags; order_tags = order tags (tag groups and tags); reservation_types

tools.name: ecellar_search_customers
tools.description: Customers (club members and buyers) with contact details, type, source, tags, email consent and default addresses. Personal data: use only what the task needs. POST /customers. Date filters: ISO date or date-time (e.g. 2026-01-31 or 2026-01-31T14:00:00Z; a date means 00:00 UTC).

tools.name: ecellar_search_addresses
tools.description: Customer billing and shipping addresses. POST /addresses. Date filters: ISO date or date-time (e.g. 2026-01-31 or 2026-01-31T14:00:00Z; a date means 00:00 UTC).

tools.name: ecellar_search_notes
tools.description: Notes on customer records (type, text, dates). POST /notes. Date filters: ISO date or date-time (e.g. 2026-01-31 or 2026-01-31T14:00:00Z; a date means 00:00 UTC).

tools.name: ecellar_search_orders
tools.description: Orders (web, POS, club and phone) with totals, status, billing and shipping details, and their lines, payments, tracking records and tags. Statuses are the enum values from ecellar_get_reference_data purchase_statuses / billing_statuses. Contains customer personal data. POST /orders. Date filters: I

tools.name: ecellar_search_order_lines
tools.description: Order lines (product, SKU, quantity, price, discount, tax) across orders. POST /orders/lines. Date filters: ISO date or date-time (e.g. 2026-01-31 or 2026-01-31T14:00:00Z; a date means 00:00 UTC).

tools.name: ecellar_search_order_payments
tools.description: Order payments (amount, type, billing status, dates, card brand, last digits and expiry; no card numbers). POST /orders/payments. Date filters: ISO date or date-time (e.g. 2026-01-31 or 2026-01-31T14:00:00Z; a date means 00:00 UTC).

tools.name: ecellar_search_order_trackings
tools.description: Carrier tracking records of orders (carrier, tracking number, shipped and delivered dates). POST /orders/trackings. Date filters: ISO date or date-time (e.g. 2026-01-31 or 2026-01-31T14:00:00Z; a date means 00:00 UTC).

tools.name: ecellar_search_products
tools.description: Products (wines and merchandise): name, SKU, price, vintage-related fields, categories and inventory SKUs. POST /products. Date filters: ISO date or date-time (e.g. 2026-01-31 or 2026-01-31T14:00:00Z; a date means 00:00 UTC).

tools.name: ecellar_search_product_categories
tools.description: Product categories (tree: parent_category_id, category_id, name). POST /products/categories. Date filters: ISO date or date-time (e.g. 2026-01-31 or 2026-01-31T14:00:00Z; a date means 00:00 UTC).

tools.name: ecellar_get_inventory_counts
tools.description: Current inventory per SKU and location: on_hand, on_hold, invoiced and available. Filter by SKUs and/or locations (ids or names from ecellar_get_reference_data locations); with no filter every SKU and location is returned. POST /inventory/counts.

tools.name: ecellar_search_club_subscriptions
tools.description: Wine club subscriptions of customers: tier, signup/cancel/hold dates, billing and shipping address, card brand, last digits and expiry (no card numbers). POST /subscriptions. Date filters: ISO date or date-time (e.g. 2026-01-31 or 2026-01-31T14:00:00Z; a date means 00:00 UTC).

tools.name: ecellar_search_club_tiers
tools.description: Wine club tiers (id, name, description, brand). POST /club/tiers. Date filters: ISO date or date-time (e.g. 2026-01-31 or 2026-01-31T14:00:00Z; a date means 00:00 UTC).

tools.name: ecellar_search_club_events
tools.description: Club events / shipments (name, date, ship group, tier, pickup location, product totals, remix window). POST /club/events. Date filters: ISO date or date-time (e.g. 2026-01-31 or 2026-01-31T14:00:00Z; a date means 00:00 UTC).

tools.name: ecellar_search_reservations
tools.description: Tasting-room and experience reservations (party, times, status, host, notes, contact phone and email). POST /reservations. Date filters: ISO date or date-time (e.g. 2026-01-31 or 2026-01-31T14:00:00Z; a date means 00:00 UTC).

tools.name: ecellar_mark_order_shipped
tools.description: WRITE: set the shipped date and status of ONE order, to be used when ALL its packages have shipped. eCellar refuses it unless the order status is EXPORTED, HOLD_SHIP, SHIPPED, TO_PICKUP or UNSHIPPED, the date is not before the order date, and the date matches the latest tracking ship date. Check the

tools.name: ecellar_mark_order_delivered
tools.description: WRITE: set the delivered date and status of ONE order, to be used when ALL its packages were delivered. eCellar refuses it unless the order status is DELIVERED or SHIPPED and the date matches the latest tracking delivered date. PATCH /order/{order_id}/delivered.

tools.name: ecellar_add_order_tracking
tools.description: WRITE: add a carrier tracking record (carrier + tracking number, optional shipped/delivered dates) to ONE order. Adds a record each call; a duplicate tracking number on the same order is refused by eCellar. Get carrier_enum from ecellar_get_reference_data carriers. POST /order/{order_id}/tracking.

tools.name: ecellar_adjust_inventory_count
tools.description: WRITE: change the on-hand count of ONE SKU at ONE location by a signed amount (+12 adds, -3 removes; it is a delta, not a new total, so repeating it repeats the change). Pass location_id or location_name; eCellar refuses an unknown or ambiguous location, a SKU that is not at that location, or a resu

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ecellar_search_customers, ecellar_search_addresses, ecellar_search_notes, ecellar_search_orders, ecellar_search_order_lines, ecellar_search_order_payments, ecellar_search_order_trackings, ecellar_search_products, ecellar_search_product_categories, ecellar_get_inventory_counts, ecellar_search_club_subscriptions, ecellar_search_club_tiers, ecellar_search_club_events, ecellar_search_reservations, ecellar_add_order_tracking · Private data: ecellar_search_customers, ecellar_search_notes, ecellar_search_orders, ecellar_search_order_trackings, ecellar_search_reservations, ecellar_mark_order_shipped, ecellar_add_order_tracking · Public sink: ecellar_search_customers, ecellar_search_addresses, ecellar_search_notes, ecellar_search_orders, ecellar_search_order_lines, ecellar_search_order_payments, ecellar_search_order_trackings, ecellar_search_products, ecellar_search_product_categories, ecellar_get_inventory_counts, ecellar_search_club_subscriptions, ecellar_search_club_tiers, ecellar_search_club_events, ecellar_search_reservations, ecellar_add_order_tracking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ecellar_search_customers, ecellar_search_addresses, ecellar_search_notes, ecellar_search_orders, ecellar_search_order_lines, ecellar_search_order_payments, ecellar_search_order_trackings, ecellar_search_products, ecellar_search_product_categories, ecellar_get_inventory_counts, ecellar_search_club_subscriptions, ecellar_search_club_tiers, ecellar_search_club_events, ecellar_search_reservations, ecellar_add_order_tracking · Private data: ecellar_search_customers, ecellar_search_notes, ecellar_search_orders, ecellar_search_order_trackings, ecellar_search_reservations, ecellar_mark_order_shipped, ecellar_add_order_tracking · Public sink: ecellar_search_customers, ecellar_search_addresses, ecellar_search_notes, ecellar_search_orders, ecellar_search_order_lines, ecellar_search_order_payments, ecellar_search_order_trackings, ecellar_search_products, ecellar_search_product_categories, ecellar_get_inventory_counts, ecellar_search_club_subscriptions, ecellar_search_club_tiers, ecellar_search_club_events, ecellar_search_reservations, ecellar_add_order_tracking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
